author_or_org: Meghan Fitzpatrick, Ritu Gill, Jennifer F. Giles
abstract_or_snippet: While propaganda and disinformation have been used to destabilize opposing forces throughout history, the US military remains unprepared for the way these methods have been adapted to the Internet era.
